name: Log Directory Usage (% of PVC Requested Capacity)
programText:
a = data('kafka_log_log_value', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'Size') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kafka-0')).sum()
b = data('kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('persistentvolumeclaim', 'data0-kafka-0')).sum()
(a/b*100).publish(label='Log Dir Usage %')
